title: Responsible AI in Construction Safety: Systematic Evaluation of Large Language Models and Prompt Engineering

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative error analysis of the lowest-performing multiple-choice questions to observe instances where the model inappropriately favored recently provided information at the expense of earlier context.

Evaluating model accuracy across different answer formats by comparing traditional labeled options (A, B, C, D) against a label-free, spelled-out format to assess the impact of output constraints and option presentation.
